commits.args: 'aalt' Access All Alternates in Latin lookup 0
commits.subject: Drop the aalt lookup the release does not carry
commits.body:
Megrim.ttf was exported by FontForge 20110222 with OpenType output off
(no GSUB, GPOS or GDEF; usMaxContext 1), so this lookup never shipped.
The absence exists only in the release; the glyphs stay.
